input.title: Unisex Rabbit – Chewed the Charger. Feel Great. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

CHEWED THE CHARGER. FEEL GREAT. is the rabbit hoodie for the house-rabbit owner who keeps buying cables, worn at home, on errands for more cables and as a gift from friends who have seen the damage.

CHEWED THE CHARGER. stacks over two lines across the top and FEEL GREAT. fills the bottom in huge slab capitals. Between them a round brown-and-white house rabbit sits upright and smug, ears up and eyes half closed, with a chewed white cable hanging from its mouth and a few strands of hay on the floor.

Navy carries cream and carrot orange lettering with a cream edge around the rabbit; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this rabbit hoodie warm enough for cool evenings at home?
Yes. The Chewed the Charger. Feel Great. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cool evenings, errands and time at home with a bunny.

How does the Chewed the Charger. Feel Great. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a rabbit owner?
It is a natural one. Every house-rabbit owner has lost a cable to a smug bunny, so it lands with rabbit rescuers, pet-store regulars and friends who have seen the damage. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the rabbit sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Chewed the Charger. Feel Great. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
